$schema: Plant Disease Knowledge Base Entry v1.0
description: Schema for every disease/healthy entry. All fields marked REQUIRED must be filled before review. Fields marked OPTIONAL can be null.

class_name.note: Exact PlantVillage class name e.g. Tomato___Late_blight

crop.note: Human readable crop name e.g. Tomato

disease.note: Human readable disease name. Use 'Healthy' for healthy classes.

cause_type.note: One of: fungal | bacterial | viral | pest | none (for healthy)

symptoms.note: Description of visible symptoms on the leaf/plant

chemical_options.note: List of {product, active_ingredient, dose, source} objects

sources.note: List of {title, url, accessed_on} for all content

reviewed_by.note: Name of agronomist or supervisor who reviewed this entry
